summary: Ericsson reported weekly share repurchases via Form 6-K, covering May 11-15, 2026. It bought 1,119,106 Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 116.99, for total consideration of SEK 130.9 million, under a SEK 15 billion buyback program announced April 16, 2026, running through March 31, 2027. The board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares at the 2027 AGM. Acquisitions were executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE. Treasury stock now totals 47.9 million Class B shares. Watch for continued execution; no price or premium is disclosed as this is an open-market program.
